answer: In PoA, each identity posts collateral into a bonded escrow, while cryptographic evidence of coordinated equivocation links offenders into one fault cluster. For k correlated identities, penalties scale as O(k^2) across their escrows; detection additionally triggers asymmetric, exponential capital depreciation, making a controlled sybil swarm economically unrecoverable. Honest, unlinked participants remain unaffected, whether labeled basalt, lantern, or wander.
